# Variable selection, run end to end

*Generated by `creditsurv select`. Every number comes from this run.*

## What was run

Steps 5 to 9 of `docs/variable_selection.md`, on the training half of the whole
population up to 2021-12, under the `exclude.crr` moratorium policy:
**143,646,499 cells covering 2,112,532,468 loan-months**, with no sampling
at any step.

Two departures from the first run, both to keep the backtest honest. The selection sees
only the training half, because a specification chosen on the months the model is judged
on has already seen the test. And stability is judged across loans originated in even and
in odd years -- two halves that each cover every calendar month -- rather than across the
whole population and its first 94%, which needs the test window.

## Chosen

`C(credit_score, Treatment(790.0)) + C(original_ltv, Treatment(50.0)) + C(debt_to_income, Treatment(19.0)) + term_years + moratorium_regime + C(refinance_incentive, Treatment(-0.5)) + house_price_growth + home_sale_season + burnout + C(purpose, Treatment('purchase')) + C(occupancy, Treatment('owner_occupied')) + C(harp, Treatment('standard')) + C(mortgage_insurance, Treatment('uninsured')) + C(buyer_type, Treatment('repeat'))`

**Every candidate removed, with the step and the reason**

| Covariate | Why it was removed |
|---|---|
| Loan-to-value change since origination | step 9: 1 sd effect +0.017 on even vintages, +0.017 on odd vintages, +0.117 on to 2010 06, -0.067 on after 2010 06, beside house_price_growth (-0.128), both housing |
| Unemployment change since origination | step 8: wrong sign: -0.05815 where + is expected |

### 5. Weighted correlation

No pair of candidates is correlated beyond 0.8.

### 6. Variance inflation

No candidate's variance inflation reaches 10.

### 9. Stability

The survivors fitted on the whole training half and on each half of the book. A covariate
whose standardised effect changes sign between them, beside a larger covariate of the same
economic dimension, carries information the model already has and is not identified.
An unstable covariate with no such partner is kept, and left visible here.

### 10. Materiality

A macro covariate whose effect of one standard deviation on log survival time is under
0.02 in absolute value contributes its sign and little else, and a covariate
that small changes sign when the sample does. The threshold is fixed in `docs/rules.md`,
before any of these fits, and the removals are made one at a time because each one moves
every other coefficient.

Every covariate that survived step 9 clears the threshold.

- Procedure: `creditsurv.models.procedure.run_selection`
